method.method_draft: From the image, take A = (10 cm)(5 cm) = 0.1 m × 0.05 m = 0.005 m^2. From the text, B(t)=0.25 sin(ωt), ω=2π×50 rad/s, R=0.4 Ω, and N=1. Compute induced emf amplitude E_m = N A B_m ω = 1×0.005×0.25×(2π×50). Convert to RMS: E_rms = E_m/√2. Then compute average power absorbed in the resistance as P = E_rms^2/0.4, giving about 0.19 W.
